This can be used to make canonical URLs for the cache that omit insignificant query parameters or other irrelevant data. This feature may be used with `POST` requests to cache their responses. In such cases the request body is not used to determine the cache key, so you must manually add cache-relevant data to the override URL. For example, you could add a `request-body-sha256` query parameter so requests with the same POST data get the same cache entry.
name: cache_url_override_controls_cache_key

evidence: `HttpLoggingInterceptor.redactQueryParams()` configures the query parameters to redact in logs. For best security, don't put sensitive information in query parameters.
name: logging_redacts_configured_query_parameters

evidence: `ConnectionPool.setPolicy()` configures a minimum connection pool size for a target address. Use this to proactively open HTTP connections. Connections opened to fulfill this policy are subject to the connection pool's `keepAliveDuration` but do not count against the pool-wide `maxIdleConnections` limit. This feature increases the client's traffic and the load on the server. Talking to your server's operators before adopting it.
name: connection_pool_policy_maintains_minimum_idle_connections

evidence: `OkHttpClient.webSocketCloseTimeout` configures how long a web socket connection will wait for a graceful shutdown before it performs an abrupt shutdown.
name: websocket_close_timeout_forces_abrupt_shutdown

evidence: Prefer the client's configured precedence order for TLS cipher suites. (OkHttp used to prefer the JDK’s precedence order.) This change may cause your HTTP calls to negotiate a different cipher suite than before! OkHttp's defaults cipher suites are selected for good security and performance.
name: client_cipher_suite_precedence_is_honored

evidence: `ConnectionListener` publishes events for connects, disconnects, and use of pooled connections.
name: connection_listener_reports_connect_disconnect_and_pooling

evidence: Immediately update the connection's flow control window instead of waiting for the receiving stream to process it. This change may increase OkHttp's memory use for applications that make many concurrent HTTP calls and that can receive data faster than they can process it. Previously, OkHttp limited HTTP/2 to 16 MiB of unacknowledged data per connection. With this fix there is a limit of 16 MiB of unacknowledged data per stream and no per-connection limit.
name: http2_flow_control_window_updates_before_application_read

evidence: Don't close a `Deflater` while we're still using it to compress a web socket message. We had a severe bug where web sockets were closed on the wrong thread, which caused `NullPointerException` crashes in `Deflater`.
name: websocket_deflater_is_not_closed_mid_message

evidence: Don't crash after a web socket fails its connection upgrade. We incorrectly released the web socket's connections back to the pool before their resources were cleaned up.
name: websocket_failed_upgrade_does_not_crash

evidence: Don't infinite loop when a received web socket message has self-terminating compressed data.
name: websocket_self_terminating_compressed_message_does_not_loop

evidence: Recover gracefully when a cached response is corrupted on disk.
name: corrupted_cache_entry_is_recovered_or_fails_fast

evidence: Don't leak file handles when a cache disk write fails.
name: cache_write_failure_does_not_leak_or_crash

evidence: Don't hang when the public suffix database cannot be loaded. We had a bug where a failure reading the public suffix database would cause subsequent reads to hang when they should have crashed.
name: public_suffix_load_failure_fails_fast_forever

evidence: `Cookie.sameSite` determines whether cookies should be sent on cross-site requests. This is used by servers to defend against Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.

evidence: Log the total time of the HTTP call in `HttpLoggingInterceptor`.
name: logging_reports_total_call_time

evidence: `mockwebserver3.RecordedRequest.handshakeServerNames` returns the SNI (Server Name Indication) attribute from the TLS handshake.
name: recorded_request_reports_tls_sni

evidence: Enable fast fallback by default. It's our implementation of Happy Eyeballs, [RFC 8305][rfc_8305]. Disable with `OkHttpClient.Builder.fastFallback(false)`.
name: fast_fallback_races_tcp_connections

evidence: Don't log response bodies for server-sent events.
name: server_sent_event_bodies_are_not_logged

evidence: Don't log sensitive headers in `Request.toString()`.
name: request_to_string_redacts_sensitive_headers

evidence: Enforce label length limits in URLs. `HttpUrl` now rejects URLs whose domains aren't valid. This includes overly-long domain names (longer than 253 characters), overly-long labels (more than 63 characters between dots), and empty labels.
name: url_domain_label_length_limits_are_enforced

name: multipart_body_omits_aggregate_content_length

evidence: Change how `H2_PRIOR_KNOWLEDGE` works with HTTP proxies. Previously OkHttp assumed the proxy itself was a prior knowledge HTTP/2 server. name: h2_prior_knowledge_does_not_tunnel_through_http_proxy

evidence: Don't interpret trailers as headers after an HTTP/100 response. This was a bug only when the HTTP response body itself is empty.
name: http_100_empty_body_trailers_are_not_promoted_to_headers

evidence: Don't crash when a fast fallback call has both a deferred connection and a held connection.
name: fast_fallback_deferred_and_held_connection_race_does_not_crash

evidence: Don't ask `Dns` implementations to resolve strings that are already IP addresses.
name: dns_is_not_called_for_literal_ip_addresses

evidence: Don't silently ignore calls to `EventSource.cancel()` made from `EventSourceListener.onOpen()`.
name: eventsource_cancel_from_onopen_is_honored

evidence: Enforce the max intermediates constraint when using pinned certificates with Conscrypt. This impacts Conscrypt when the server's presented certificates form both a trusted-but-unpinned chain and an untrusted-but-pinned chain.
name: certificate_pinner_builds_full_chains

evidence: Don't crash if a cookie's value is a lone double quote character.
name: cookie_lone_quote_value_does_not_crash

evidence: Use TLSv1.3 when running on JDK 8u261 or newer.
name: tls13_is_enabled_on_modern_jdk

evidence: DNS over HTTPS is now a stable feature of OkHttp. We introduced this as an experimental module in 2018. We are confident in its stable API and solid implementation.
name: dns_over_https_executes_wire_dns_queries

evidence: Fail fast when a private key cannot be encoded.
name: private_key_encoding_failure_fails_fast

evidence: Fail fast when attempting to verify a non-ASCII hostname.
name: non_ascii_hostname_fails_before_tls_verification

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash in HttpUrl.topPrivateDomain() when the hostname is malformed.
name: top_private_domain_malformed_host_does_not_crash

evidence: Fix: Don’t attempt Brotli decompression if the response body is empty.
name: brotli_empty_body_is_not_decompressed

evidence: New: HandshakeCertificates.Builder.addInsecureHost() makes it easy to turn off security in private development environments that only carry test data. Prefer this over creating an all-trusting TrustManager because only hosts on the allowlist are insecure. From our DevServer sample: val clientCertificates = HandshakeCertificates.Builder() .addPlatformTrustedCertificates() .addInsecureHost("localhost") .build() val client = OkHttpClient.Builder() .sslSocketFactory(clientCertificates.sslSocketFactory(), clientCertificates.trustManager) .build()

evidence: New: Add cacheHit , cacheMiss , and cacheConditionalHit() events to EventListener . Use these in logs, metrics, and even test cases to confirm your cache headers are configured as expected.
name: cache_hit_miss_events_are_emitted

evidence: Fix: Include the header Accept: text/event-stream for SSE calls. This header is not added if the request already contains an Accept header.
name: sse_calls_send_accept_event_stream_by_default

evidence: Fix: Include the header Accept: text/event-stream for SSE calls. This header is not added if the request already contains an Accept header.
name: sse_preserves_existing_accept_header

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash with a NullPointerException if a server sends a close while we’re sending a ping. OkHttp had a race condition bug.
name: websocket_ping_close_race_does_not_crash

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash decompressing web sockets messages. We had a bug where we assumed deflated bytes in would always yield deflated bytes out and this isn’t always the case!
name: websocket_deflated_empty_output_does_not_crash

name: multipart_reader_streams_response_parts
setup: response content_type "multipart/mixed; boundary=abc" body_parts ["a","b"] streaming true

evidence: New: MediaType.parameter() gets a parameter like boundary from a media type like multipart/mixed; boundary="abc" .
name: media_type_parameter_extracts_quoted_boundary

evidence: New: CertificatePinner now offers an API for inspecting the configured pins.
name: certificate_pinner_pins_are_inspectable

evidence: Fix: don’t return stale DNS entries in DnsOverHttps . We were caching DNS results indefinitely rather than the duration specified in the response’s cache-control header.
name: dns_over_https_honors_response_cache_ttl

evidence: New: OkHttpClient.Builder.minWebSocketMessageToCompress() configures a threshold for compressing outbound web socket messages. evidence: Fix: Don’t crash when the URL hostname contains an underscore on Android.

evidence: New: Include suppressed exceptions when all routes to a target service fail.
name: all_route_failures_include_suppressed_exceptions

evidence: Fix: Don’t reuse a connection on redirect if certs match but DNS does not. For better locality and performance OkHttp attempts to use the same pooled connection across redirects and follow-ups. It independently shares connections when the IP addresses and certificates match, even if the host names do not. In 4.4.0 we introduced a regression where we shared a connection when certificates matched but the DNS addresses did not. This would only occur when following a redirect from one hostname to another, and where both hosts had common certificates.
name: redirect_does_not_reuse_connection_when_dns_differs

evidence: Fix: Don’t fail on a redirect when a client has configured a ‘trust everything’ trust manager. Typically this would cause certain redirects to fail in debug and development configurations.
name: trust_everything_redirect_does_not_fail

evidence: New: Support canceled() as an event that can be observed by EventListener . This should be useful for splitting out canceled calls in metrics.
name: event_listener_canceled_event_is_emitted

evidence: Fix: Limit retry attempts for HTTP/2 REFUSED_STREAM and CANCEL failures.
name: http2_refused_stream_and_cancel_retries_are_limited

evidence: Fix: Retry automatically when incorrectly sharing a connection among multiple hostnames. OkHttp shares connections when hosts share both IP addresses and certificates, such as squareup.com and www.squareup.com . If a server refuses such sharing it will return HTTP 421 and OkHttp will automatically retry on an unshared connection.
name: http_421_retries_on_unshared_connection

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash if a TLS tunnel’s response body is truncated.
name: tls_tunnel_truncated_response_body_does_not_crash

evidence: Fix: Don’t track unusable routes beyond their usefulness. We had a bug where we could track certain bad routes indefinitely; now we only track the ones that could be necessary.
name: unusable_routes_are_not_tracked_indefinitely

evidence: Fix: Defer proxy selection until a proxy is required. This saves calls to ProxySelector on calls that use a pooled connection.
name: proxy_selection_is_deferred_until_needed

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash with a NullPointerException when a web socket is closed before it connects. This regression was introduced in OkHttp 4.3.0.
name: websocket_closed_before_connect_does_not_crash

evidence: Fix: Explicitly specify the remote server name when making HTTPS connections on Android 5. In 4.3.0 we introduced a regression where server name indication (SNI) was broken on Android 5.
name: android_https_sets_sni_server_name

evidence: Fix: Don’t call EventListener.responseHeadersStart() or responseBodyStart() until bytes have been received. Previously these events were incorrectly sent too early, when OkHttp was ready to read the response headers or body, which mislead tracing tools. Note that the responseFailed() event always used to follow one of these events; now it may be sent without them.
name: response_start_events_wait_for_actual_bytes

evidence: New: Match any number of subdomains with two asterisks in CertificatePinner . For example, **.squareup.com matches us-west.www.squareup.com , www.squareup.com and squareup.com .
name: certificate_pinner_double_wildcard_matches_multiple_subdomain_depths

evidence: Fix: Don’t drop callbacks on unexpected exceptions. When an interceptor throws an unchecked exception the callback is now notified that the call was canceled. The exception is still sent to the uncaught exception handler for reporting and recovery.
name: unexpected_interceptor_exception_notifies_callback_failure

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash on HTTP/2 HEAD requests when the Content-Length header is present but is not consistent with the length of the response body.
name: http2_head_inconsistent_content_length_does_not_crash

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash when converting a HttpUrl instance with an unresolvable hostname to a URI. The new behavior strips invalid characters like " and { from the hostname before converting.

evidence: Fix: Honor RequestBody.isOneShot() in HttpLoggingInterceptor .
name: logging_interceptor_honors_one_shot_request_body

evidence: Fix: When closing a canceled HTTP/2 stream, don’t send the END_STREAM flag. This could cause the server to incorrectly interpret the stream as having completed normally. This is most useful when a request body needs to cancel its own call.
name: http2_self_cancel_does_not_send_end_stream

evidence: Fix: In 4.1.0 we introduced a performance regression that prevented connections from being pooled in certain situations. This particularly-subtle bug was caused by us assigning each OkHttpClient instance its own NullProxySelector when an explicit proxy is configured. But we don’t share connections when the proxy selectors are different. Ugh!

setup: two_clients share_connection_pool true explicit_proxy same_proxy true

evidence: Fix: Don’t drop repeated headers when validating cached responses. In our Kotlin upgrade we introduced a regression where we iterated the number of unique header names rather than then number of unique headers. If you’re using OkHttp’s response cache this may impact you.
name: cached_response_preserves_repeated_headers

evidence: New: EventListener.proxySelectStart() , proxySelectEnd() events give visibility into the proxy selection process.
name: proxy_selection_events_are_emitted

evidence: New: Permit new WebSocket response codes: 1012 (Service Restart), 1013 (Try Again Later), and 1014 (invalid response from the upstream).

evidence: Fix: Recover gracefully when a coalesced connection immediately goes unhealthy.

evidence: Fix: Don’t permit cache iterators to remove entries that are being written.
name: cache_iterator_does_not_evict_incomplete_entries

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash if the connection is closed when sending a degraded ping. This fixes a regression that was introduced in OkHttp 3.14.5.
name: degraded_http2_ping_closed_connection_does_not_crash

evidence: Fix: Lock in a route when recovering from an HTTP/2 connection error. We had a bug where two calls that failed at the same time could cause OkHttp to crash with a NoSuchElementException instead of the expected IOException .
name: http2_route_lock_prevents_concurrent_recovery_crash

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash when an interceptor retries when there are no more routes. This was an edge-case regression introduced with the events cleanup in 3.14.0.
name: interceptor_retry_no_more_routes_fails_as_io_error

evidence: New: Prevent OkHttp from retransmitting a request body by overriding RequestBody.isOneShot() . This is most useful when writing the request body is destructive.
name: one_shot_request_body_is_not_retransmitted

evidence: New: We’ve added requestFailed() and responseFailed() methods to EventListener . These are called instead of requestBodyEnd() and responseBodyEnd() in some failure situations. evidence: Fix: Don’t leak a connection when a call is canceled immediately preceding the onFailure() callback.
name: cancel_before_failure_callback_releases_connection

evidence: Fix: Apply call timeouts when connecting duplex calls, web sockets, and server-sent events. Once the streams are established no further timeout is enforced.
name: call_timeout_applies_while_connecting_long_lived_streams

evidence: Fix: Retain the Route when a connection is reused on a redirect or other follow-up. This was causing some Authenticator calls to see a null route when non-null was expected.
name: route_is_retained_on_reused_followup_connection

evidence: New: You can now access HTTP trailers with Response.trailers() . This method may only be called after the entire HTTP response body has been read.
name: response_trailers_available_after_body_exhausted

evidence: Fix: Don’t miss cancels when sending HTTP/2 request headers.
name: http2_cancel_while_sending_headers_is_not_missed

evidence: Fix: Don’t miss whole operation timeouts when calls redirect.
name: call_timeout_is_preserved_across_redirects

evidence: Fix: Don’t leak connections if web sockets have malformed responses or if onOpen() throws.
name: websocket_malformed_response_or_onopen_exception_releases_connection

evidence: Fix: Don’t retry when request bodies fail due to FileNotFoundException .
name: file_not_found_request_body_is_not_retried

evidence: New: Fail fast if a SSLSocketFactory is used as a SocketFactory .
name: ssl_socket_factory_cannot_be_used_as_plain_socket_factory

evidence: New: Log the TLS handshake in LoggingEventListener .
name: logging_event_listener_reports_tls_handshake

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash if the HTTPS server returns no certificates in the TLS handshake.
name: tls_handshake_without_peer_certificates_fails_cleanly

evidence: New: Headers can be redacted in HttpLoggingInterceptor .
name: http_logging_interceptor_redacts_configured_headers

evidence: Fix: Handle dispatcher executor shutdowns gracefully. When there aren’t any threads to carry a call its callback now gets a RejectedExecutionException .
name: dispatcher_executor_shutdown_reports_rejected_execution

evidence: Fix: Don’t permanently cache responses with Cache-Control: immutable . We misunderstood the original immutable proposal!
name: immutable_cache_control_is_not_permanent

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash if the system default authenticator is null.
name: null_default_authenticator_does_not_crash

evidence: Fix: Don’t leak socket connections when web socket upgrades fail.
name: websocket_failed_upgrade_does_not_leak_socket

evidence: New: okhttp-sse is an early preview of Server-Sent Events (SSE). This feature is incomplete and is only suitable for experimental use.

evidence: Fix: Don’t release HTTP/2 connections that have multiple canceled calls. We had a bug where canceling calls would cause the shared HTTP/2 connection to be unnecessarily released. This harmed connection reuse.

evidence: Fix: Ensure canceled and discarded HTTP/2 data is not permanently counted against the limited flow control window. We had a few bugs where window size accounting was broken when streams were canceled or reset.

evidence: Fix: Recover gracefully if the TLS session returns an unexpected version ( NONE ) or cipher suite ( SSL_NULL_WITH_NULL_NULL ).

evidence: Fix: Prefer TLSv1.2 where it is available. On certain older platforms it is necessary to opt-in to TLSv1.2.

evidence: Fix: Release the connection if Authenticator throws an exception.

evidence: Fix: Reverse suppression of connect exceptions. When both a call and its retry fail, we now throw the initial exception which is most likely to be actionable.

evidence: Fix: Retain interrupted state when throwing InterruptedIOException . A single interrupt should now be sufficient to break out an in-flight OkHttp call.

evidence: New: Allow request bodies for all HTTP methods except GET and HEAD.

evidence: Fix: Do not count web sockets toward the dispatcher’s per-host connection limit.

evidence: Fix: Don’t corrupt the response cache when a 304 (Not Modified) response overrides the stored “Content-Encoding” header.

evidence: Fix: Don’t crash reading non-ASCII characters in HTTP/2 headers or in cached HTTP headers.
